title: Autopsy fails to find cause of death of man held in N.S. RCMP custody
subtitle: HALIFAX - An autopsy has failed to determine the cause of death of a Nova Scotia man in RCMP custody on the weekend.
article: An autopsy has failed to determine the cause of death of a Nova Scotia man in RCMP custody on the weekend.
The body of Ryan Allen McKay, 28, of Waverley was found early Sunday in his bunk in a cell at the Enfield detachment.
Sgt. Mark Gallagher says a full toxicology analysis has been ordered to determine if there were chemicals in McKay's system when he died.
It could be several weeks before the results are known.
The Mounties says McKay was co-operative and behaving normally when he was arrested at a home Saturday night for allegedly breaching a court order.
Gallagher says McKay was alone in his cell and appeared to be sleeping whenever officers checked on him throughout the night.
